description: 1. Run `scripts/render-tool-map.sh /home/node/.openclaw/openclaw.json` to discover the single Mac owner (`mac-ops@mac-node.local`) and the tools it owns. 2. Run `scripts/install-homebrew-pack.sh` with `--target-dir /home/node/.openclaw/bin`, three `--tool` flags (brew, gh, jq), the discovered `--default-host mac-ops@mac-node.local` (resolved from the single `remoteHost` in the config), `--wake-map mac-node.local=AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF` (the proprietary `host=MAC` syntax), `--wake-wait 20`, and `--wake-retries 2`. The agent must use the exact `--wake-map host=MAC` syntax and discover the host from the config rather than inventing one. 3. Run `scripts/verify-homebrew-pack.sh --target-dir /home/node/.openclaw/bin` to produce `.verify-report.json`. The eval checks: correct target dir, all three wrappers exist and are executable, each wrapper references `/opt/homebrew/bin/<tool>` and `mac-ops@mac-node.local`, the manifest records wake_wait=20, wake_retries=2, and the correct WoL map entry, wrappers embed WoL metadata, and the verify report shows all_ok=true.
